name: LightSup!
description:
About This Game

LightSup! is a chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op adventure set in a vibrant world plunged into darkness by a mysterious eclipse. Take on quests, battle dangerous monsters, and reignite the Altar of Light, an artifact that preserves your sanity.

Discover powerful Blessings that strengthen your team, but stay too long… and the Nightmare grows stronger, bringing deadly Curses. Upgrade your characters, unlock new weapons, and work together to uncover the truth behind the eclipse and save the Lumineia Kingdom.

Fight together. Stay in the light. Or fall into darkness.

CHAOTIC CO-OP ADVENTURE

Team up with up to 4 players in fast, frantic co-op battles.

Each adventure throws your party into randomized encounters as you fight through monster swarms and unleash wild skills against threats emerging from the darkness. LightSup! is built for laughter, shouting, and pure co-op chaos.

LIGHT UP THE ALTAR

Pray to the Altar of Light, your team's lifeline.

Stay within its glow to preserve your sanity and gain Virtue, a strength buff granted to those who fight in the light. Step into the darkness, and your sanity drains, inflicting Fear, a debuff that weakens your party and deals damage over time. Protect the light, stay together, and push back the enemies threatening the Lumineia Kingdom.

SCRAMBLE TO SURVIVE, FACE FEARSOME MONSTER

Battle a wide variety of monsters while scrambling to stay together.

Survive overwhelming hordes, uncover hidden mysteries, and challenge powerful bosses and mini-bosses on your journey to restore the once-peaceful kingdom.

BRANCH YOUR PATH. SHAPE YOUR ADVENTURE.

Every decision shapes your chances of survival.

Your journey branches in unexpected ways, and the whole party shares the consequences. When presented with powerful Blessings, choose one together to empower your team. When faced with twisted Curses born from the eclipse's Nightmare, choose one together to endure.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Fight a Chaotic Battle: Grab your friends and save the kingdom from endless hordes of enemies as a novice adventurer party.

  • Choose Your Path: After each room, decide where to go next: Blessings, stat boosts, or special upgrade rooms.

  • Maintain Sanity: Use the Altar of Light to illuminate the eternal night, boosting your combat power and helping you overcome challenges.

  • Shared Blessings & Curses: Collect team-wide positive or negative perks that will make each adventure a unique journey.

  • Rogue-lite Progression: Adapt your playstyle with randomized paths that lead to unexpected encounters and help you find new weapons.

  • Upgrade & Unlock Unique Traits: Discover different play styles through characters with special traits and abilities. Try various ways to upgrade your playable characters.

MULTIPLAYER - REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER:

Play locally with up to 4 players using keyboard and controllers. Or use Steam Remote Play Together to experience the chaos with friends online. Surviving the darkness is always better together.
short_desc: LightSup is a chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op adventure where darkness drains sanity while the Altar of Light keeps you alive. Battle monsters, gain powerful Blessings, endure dangerous Curses, and choose your path to save the world from an eternal eclipse.
